title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: Notation is inconsistent: Ĝ on the previous page, 𝔊 here. Equation numbers are reused: (17) appears twice on the previous page, and (4) here should presumably be (4').
Normality of Im L0 in (21) requires u(l) = l^μ exactly, not merely up to conjugacy. This must be built into the definition of B_{ρ,σ}; it is not derived on the page.
In condition (4') the role of β is left implicit: η = ε2(μ) can only hold after conjugation by β. As written, the statement is incomplete or garbled.

Surjectivity of χ_Γ onto Ẑ*, implicit in the exact sequence (25) ending in → 1, is asserted without proof. It needs the existence of automorphisms realizing every μ (e.g. from Galois or 'Frobenius-like' automorphisms).

ideas.what: Group B of automorphisms of the profinite modular-type group preserving the conjugacy classes of ρ, σ up to the power μ, parametrized by triples (ξ, η, μ) subject to a 'loop relation' ξ = η l1^{(μ−1)/2}
ideas.modern_name: Genus-one / modular analogue of the Grothendieck–Teichmüller group (GT-type parametrization by (λ, f))
ideas.usually_credited_to: Drinfeld 1990 (GT); genus-one variants by Nakamura, Lochak–Nakamura–Schneps, Enriquez (elliptic GT, 2014)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme alludes to the Teichmüller tower and the modular groups in genus one; no explicit formulas published

ideas.what: Quotient by inner automorphisms coming from the loop subgroup L0, assuming L0 ∩ Centre = 1, giving 1 → L0 → B → Γ → 1 and a cyclotomic character χ_Γ: Γ → Ẑ* with kernel Γ^+
ideas.modern_name: Outer-automorphism version / GT-type group with cyclotomic character

ideas.what: Reformulation of the conjugacy conditions as explicit existence of conjugators α (twisted by τ^{ν3(μ)} when μ ≢ 1 mod 3) and β, using the characters ε2, ε3 of Ẑ*
ideas.modern_name: Description of automorphisms of profinite SL2(Z) / B3 preserving inertia (torsion) classes
ideas.usually_credited_to: Nakamura; Minamide–Nakamura (automorphisms of profinite braid groups, ~2019)

missed.claim: Grothendieck sets up an explicit GT-type group Γ_{ρ,σ} attached to the profinite modular group. It is parametrized by triples (ξ, η, μ) with an explicit 'loop equation' ξ = η l1^{(μ−1)/2}, and comes with sign characters ε2, ε3 and a 'Teichmüller-like' extension G_{ρ,σ}. Whether he determined Γ_{ρ,σ} (e.g. compared it with Ĝ_Q or GT) is not visible here.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This gives an early, independent definition of a genus-one/modular GT-type group via the 'équation des lacets'. It could be compared with later work on Out of the profinite SL2(Z) and B3 and on elliptic GT (Enriquez), to see whether his parametrization adds constraints.

deep.surprise_reason: The algebra on the page is routine, but it documents Grothendieck defining, around the mid-1980s, a GT-like group for the modular/genus-one case with explicit loop equations. This predates and parallels later work, yet appears only in unpublished notes.
transcription_corrections: 'la relation des Conti (16)' is likely 'la relation des lacets (16)'.
'i.e. α mod 𝔊 = τ^{ν3(μ)}' should probably read 'α mod 𝔊' (the larger group 𝔊' modulo 𝔊), not 'α mod 𝔊' alone.
'son image est normal' should read 'son image est normale'.
'où μ est la multiplication' is probably 'où μ est le multiplicateur'.
'comme un homomorphisme' is probably 'on a un homomorphisme'.
'ξ = αρ(α)^{-1}' likely means ξ = α·ρα^{-1}ρ^{-1}, i.e. α times the ρ-conjugate of α^{-1}.
